manifest_row.title: Why I support the Carmichael mine, not Adani

screening.main_topic: An opinion piece defending the Carmichael coal mine by arguing that coal is necessary to provide electricity and improve living conditions in poor communities.
screening.climate_relevance: The piece directly invokes climate change and disputes climate-based objections to coal, arguing that denying coal access is unjust and that solar and wind cannot yet meet these communities’ needs.
screening.reason: Climate change is part of the article’s central defense of coal development, not merely a passing reference. Its arguments about fossil-fuel use, renewable energy, and the public debate over the mine make it relevant to core climate discourse.
